title: Smoothness of the principal localization of the prepared Popescu quotient
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, with an R-algebra structure and an R/pi^2R-algebra structure on Cbar, and pi an element of R. Let d be prepared polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation], and define its explicit quotient D=ULift(R[x,z]/(f_j-pi z_j, a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl})). Then the principal localization D[1/pi] is a smooth R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. No Noetherian or annihilator hypothesis and no special-fibre maps are required.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP), key equality and property (b).

proof.text: Use the cleared Prepared relations to expand pi p_{kl}=-a_k(f_l-pi z_l)+sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}(f_j-pi z_j).

After inverting pi, the p_{kl} are redundant. Substitute z_j=pi^{-1}f_j to construct inverse R-algebra maps between D[1/pi] and R[x][1/pi]. Transport across ULift. This is an explicit substitution, not a chosen arbitrary algebra.
The polynomial algebra R[x] is smooth over R. Its principal localization remains smooth, and the explicit algebra equivalence transfers this to D[1/pi].

proof_origin.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP), key equality and property (b).

    Smooth R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π))
